# Tool-A

One-line description of what this tool does and who it's for.

## Install

```
npm install tool-a
```

## Usage

```
tool-a run --input file.txt
```

## Configuration

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `--input` | required | Input file path |
| `--verbose` | false | Print extra diagnostics |
